title: Workforce MFA coverage report
description: Every workforce account and federated application with enforced factor types, plus list of non-federated systems with their MFA configuration and any exceptions.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Authenticator type distribution and policy
description: Share of authentications and of registered users by authenticator type and population; policy configuration snapshot.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Federation negative-test results
description: Results of tests for signature wrapping, unsigned assertions, wrong audience, replay and algorithm confusion per release.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Deprovisioning latency measurements
description: Measured time from SCIM deactivation to last accepted request per principal, with distribution per customer.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Password policy configuration and test results
description: Configured parameters, hashing parameters and tests for breached-password rejection and throttling.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Session configuration and revocation tests
description: Cookie attributes, timeouts, and tests demonstrating revocation on credential, contact and authority change within the stated bound.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Credential and contact change event log
description: Changes, prior-channel notices, reverts, holds and releases per principal.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Step-up binding records and negative tests
description: Per high-risk command: step-up event id, assurance achieved, age, bound parameters; tests proving rejection without a fresh matching step-up.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Integration credential register
description: Per integration: authentication method, scopes, expiry, rotation date, webhook signing status.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)
